newsitem.title: JAPAN: No supplementary budget this year or next--MOF.
newsitem.headline: No supplementary budget this year or next--MOF.

text.p: Japan's Minister of Finance Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Wednesday that the government does not plan to adopt a supplementary budget in the current fiscal year or the next fiscal year.
Mitsuzuka said Japan's fiscal condition was at a critical state and the government should not rely on supplementary budgets.
Japan should aim at achieving sustainable economic growth led by domestic demand by implementing deregulation measures to boost domestic demand, he said.
Debate on whether to draw up a supplementary budget to support Japan's farmers has been going on in the government amid pressure from politicians wanting to protect their rural support bases.
